cards.hint: "toot, toot, stuss!" — you toot your horn twice while getting acquainted
"sah, moin!" — likewise, friend!
"oy-tah!" — oy, it's night already, off to bed
"ay, pa, kess-tah!" — hey pa, no need, you're welcome
"ay, say it, Ann!" — it's nothing, no worries
"ee-hahn!" — totally, I'm a fan!
"say it's on!" — that's how it is
"meet a coo-loo (cuckoo)?" — how are you?
"ee-hahn, who-vah!" — pretty good, whoo!
"ay, key toss!" — no thanks, just toss the key
"cool-a, key toss!" — yes please, here, catch the key
"oy, key-ah-stee?" — really? oy!
"tie a tootsie!" — of course, tie it up
"eh, kah?" — eh, maybe?
"ay, hot-ta!" — no rush, it's not that hot

cards.en: have a good rest of your day
cards.hint: "who-vah, yacht-koh-ah!" — have a good day out on the yacht
"nah, then!" — see you then!
"terve, see ya!" — send my regards
"on, eck, oh cone!" — congrats, here's a cone!
"oh, leh who-vah!" — here you go, it's good!
